SELECT t.cancel_command_id,d.report_version,d.report_json,a.event_type FROM ad_reconciliation_task t LEFT JOIN ad_reconciliation_day d USING(task_id) LEFT JOIN ad_reconciliation_audit a USING(task_id) LIMIT 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_reconciliation_task(task_id,advertiser_id,start_date,end_date,reason,created_by,updated_by,next_date) VALUES(#{command.taskId},#{command.advertiserId},#{command.startDate},#{command.endDate},#{command.reason}, #{command.actor},#{command.actor},#{command.startDate}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_reconciliation_task SET state='RUNNING',version=version+1,attempts=attempts+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+#{leaseSeconds}*interval '1 second',updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND attempts<20 AND ((state='READY' AND available_at<=clock_timestamp()) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))

UPDATE ad_reconciliation_task SET state='FAILED',version=version+1,lease_until=NULL,last_failure='LEASE_EXHAUSTED', updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND state='RUNNING' AND attempts=20 AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()

UPDATE ad_reconciliation_task SET state=CASE WHEN next_date=end_date THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'READY' END, next_date=next_date+1,completed_days=completed_days+1,attempts=0,version=version+1,lease_until=NULL,last_failure=NULL, available_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE

UPDATE ad_reconciliation_task SET state='CANCELLED',version=version+1,lease_until=NULL, cancel_command_id=#{command.commandId},cancel_reason=#{command.reason},updated_by=#{command.actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND state IN ('READY','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_reconciliation_audit(task_id,version,event_type,actor,budget_date,attempts) SELECT task_id,version,#{event},updated_by,#{budgetDate},#{attempts} FROM ad_reconciliation_task WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
